title: Dimensional regularization and supersymmetry
claim: Detailed analysis of supersymmetric dimensional regularization: a manifestly supersymmetric (superfield) version leads to contradictions; removing the contradictions breaks SUSY at higher orders; an explicit three-loop example of SUSY breakdown is analysed at the diagram level; the validity of DR for global SUSY gauge theories is reconsidered.
scheme: Superfield DRED versus its consistent component reformulation.
symmetry_argument: Dichotomy: manifest SUSY (superfield) + DR is inconsistent; consistent component DR is not manifestly SUSY and fails Ward identities at higher orders.

proved: The dichotomy at the level of the regularization algebra (consistent with S2.02, S2.10).
checked_partially: The explicit three-loop breaking example is the one disputed by S2.12 and S2.13.

evidence: S2.10 hep-ph/0503129 ref. [15] groups it with S2.04.
S2.13 2603.02892 Sec. I: steps not detailed enough to identify the subtlety.
red_flags: Three-loop breaking example not confirmed by modern recomputations (S2.12, S2.13).
notes: The structural part (superfield inconsistency vs component SUSY breaking) is robust and is the same conclusion reached rigorously in S2.10.
